visualReview.scope: All six product lifestyle campaigns, both themes, desktop and mobile; longest-title tablet and wide desktop
findings: Exactly one person visible in each rendered campaign; no additional background figures found.
Faces and physical products remain visible in mobile crops.
Live title, approved scent statement and CTA remain readable with no clipping.
Dark copy overlay ends at53% of viewport and leaves right-side faces and products natural.
Everyday settings and actions remain believable and approachable.
